structuralDecisions.decision: Self-host Cinzel and Inter via @fontsource/cinzel and @fontsource/inter, imported directly in apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/src/main.ts, rather than introducing a fonts-loading abstraction or a new shared package.
structuralDecisions.rationale: main.ts already imports a third-party package's CSS directly before mount (leaflet/dist/leaflet.css at main.ts:6) for exactly this reason — side-effect CSS that must be present before the app renders. @fontsource ships per-weight CSS files that register @font-face rules against bundler-resolved local font files, so importing them the same way extends an existing, working pattern instead of adding a new one. No new layer, base class, or package is justified by two additional CSS imports.
tradeOffs: Four separate imports (cinzel/400, cinzel/700, inter/400, inter/600) in main.ts instead of one line — accepted because @fontsource's per-weight file structure is what makes exact weight verification in the new test possible; a single barrel import would pull in weights the design doesn't use.

fitness.property: src/styles.css contains no @import pointing at any origin other than the app's own build output
fitness.verification: Playwright: tests/reagent-map-globe.spec.ts's no-request test, with PRE_EXISTING_OFF_ORIGIN_HOSTS and its skip branch removed, run via scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh (and --ubi9) in CI

structuralDecisions.decision: Pin @fontsource/cinzel and @fontsource/inter to exact versions (5.3.0, no ^ or ~) in apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/package.json.
structuralDecisions.rationale: cesium is already exact-pinned in this same package.json ("cesium": "1.146.0", no range operator) while every other dependency uses ^. That establishes the local convention: packages whose CSS/asset output is asserted against in tests get exact pins so a minor bump can't silently change what's served without the test catching it first. Font files are exactly this kind of asset-shape-sensitive dependency — the new document.fonts.load test asserts on the exact weights @fontsource ships.
tradeOffs: Exact pins mean Dependabot/Renovate-style patch bumps won't land automatically; accepted because the AC explicitly requires it and the existing cesium precedent already accepts this cost for the same reason.

fitness.property: @fontsource/cinzel and @fontsource/inter versions in package.json carry no ^ or ~ prefix
fitness.verification: code-reviewer inspects apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/package.json and the pnpm-lock.yaml diff for exact version strings

structuralDecisions.decision: Do not introduce a fonts-loading utility, composable, or abstraction layer for this change.
structuralDecisions.rationale: The entire change is: remove one @import line, add four @fontsource CSS imports at the existing app-entry side-effect-import site, and tighten one test. There is no second call site, no conditional loading logic, and no future variability this chore needs to anticipate. Introducing an abstraction here would be premature generalization for a use case that doesn't exist yet (design-principles.md #7).

componentPlacement.reason: Font assets are a framework/presentation-layer concern, imported at the same side-effect site as leaflet's CSS; no domain or use-case code is affected.

crossings: reagent-map-globe's E2E no-request test (tests/reagent-map-globe.spec.ts) loses its PRE_EXISTING_OFF_ORIGIN_HOSTS exception as a direct consequence of this change

layerBoundaryChecks.rule: No OTel/instrumentation or domain logic introduced by this change — scope is CSS imports, a dependency pin, and a test file
layerBoundaryChecks.notes: Checked via Read of src/main.ts and src/styles.css directly (loom graph not queried — change has no new module boundaries to check).

antiPatternChecks.notes: Considered and rejected introducing a fonts-loading helper; direct @fontsource imports at the existing entry-point side-effect-import site are sufficient and consistent with how leaflet's CSS is already loaded.
No abstraction is being introduced, so none to leak.
